title: Read OLE Compound Files
text: olereader reads Microsoft compound files, also called OLE2 structured storage files, pure R. compound file works like small file system inside single file: storages act folders streams hold data. Older Office documents (.doc, .xls, .ppt), Outlook messages (.msg) many instrument application formats use container. olereader lists streams file, reads raw vectors extracts disk. dependencies beyond base R write compound files.

title: Read OLE Compound Files
text: ole_open() reads file’s header directory. Stream contents read ask . functions also take path place ole, ole_read("file.doc", "WordDocument"). reopen parse file every call, use ole_open() read several streams. ole_streams() lists streams, named path within file: ole_read() returns stream raw vector, can decode readBin() rawToChar(). Give path vector names one string separated /. Names match ignoring case letters Z. ole_extract() writes streams files, one folder storage. extracts every stream default, ones name streams:
code: library(olereader)  ole <- ole_open(system.file("extdata", "example.cfb", package = "olereader")) ole #> <ole_file> .../olereader/extdata/example.cfb #>   version 3, 512-byte sectors, 2 streams str(ole_streams(ole)) #> List of 2 #>  $ data        : chr "data" #>  $ notes/readme: chr [1:2] "notes" "readme" ole_size(ole, "data") #> [1] 5000  rawToChar(ole_read(ole, c("notes", "readme"))) #> [1] "This is the readme stream of the olereader example file. It is short enough to be in the mini stream." ole_extract(ole, "example") list.files("example", recursive = TRUE) #> [1] "data"         "notes/readme"  ole_extract(ole, "example", streams = "notes/readme", overwrite = TRUE)

text: Names changed work file names every platform. Control characters <>:"/\|?* replaced _, trailing dots spaces removed, names left empty (including . ..) become _, 'Windows' device names CON NUL.txt get _ prefix. names file place file outside dir. ole_extract() stops writing anything requested stream exist, two streams written file (ignoring case), streams add bytes file holds, means truncated streams sharing sectors. error stops extraction partway, files already written left place.

title: Extract OLE streams to files — ole_extract
code: ole <- ole_open(system.file("extdata", "example.cfb", package = "olereader")) dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "example") ole_extract(ole, dir) list.files(dir, recursive = TRUE) #> [1] "data"         "notes/readme"  ole_extract(ole, dir, streams = "notes/readme", overwrite = TRUE) unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
